Container.Name: WrittenSound
Container.Overview: Local-first speech-to-text with a noScribe-style transcript view, a serial job queue, and on-demand model downloads. Build the standard image from the repository first: docker build --target final-standard -t writtensound:standard .
Container.Requires: Vulkan-capable /dev/dri device for Intel/AMD GPU use. Remove ExtraParams for CPU-only.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Host port for the WrittenSound UI.

Config.Name: App data
Config.Description: Configuration, SQLite database, jobs, models, and Hugging Face cache.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Unraid user ID; files under /data are owned by this ID.

Config.Name: App password
Config.Description: Optional HTTP Basic password. Strongly recommended if the UI is reachable from other hosts.

Config.Name: Hugging Face token
Config.Description: Optional token for gated model downloads; can also be saved in the UI.

Config.Name: Demo engine
Config.Description: Set to 0 to hide the deterministic demo engine.
